title: Australia Declared War On Emus And Lost
sources: Australian War Memorial, 'The Emu War' — In November 1932, Major G.P.W. Meredith led a Royal Australian Artillery unit with two Lewis guns and 10,000 rounds to cull 20,000 emus near Campion, Western Australia.

ABC Australia / Smithsonian Magazine — Emus scattered into small groups, bullets barely slowed them; the guns were withdrawn within a week. Major Meredith joked the emus could withstand 'a military division' and ornithologist Dominic Serventy called them 'like Zulus'.

lines.text: In 1932, Australia officially declared war on emus.

The commanding major said the emus could withstand an entire army division.
